heading.title: Of the Effects of Registration and Non-registration

article.title: Time from which registered document operates.
article.content: A registered document shall operate from the time from which it would have commenced to operate if no registration thereof had been required or made, and not from the time of its registration.
article.html:
47Time from which registered document operates.

Section 47 · Part X · page 27 of the Act

A registered document shall operate from the time from which it would have commenced to operate if no registration thereof had been required or made, and not from the time of its registration.
